title: No water, soap on head, 14 taps crying 💧 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | Desi Cartoon Comedy
description:
Ek subah colony mein paani gayab! Nal sookhe hain, tanki khaali hai, aur ek bechare ke sar par soap ka jhaag ban gaya hai. Pura mohalla hairaan hai, aur 14 taps ek saath ro rahe hain. Chhotu aur gang ne investigation shuru kar di, lekin har clue ek naya drama le aata hai. Kaun sach bol raha hai, kaun bas bahane bana raha hai? Dekhiye aur hansiye! Lesson: jo sabse zyada shor machaye aur sabse meethi baatein kare, usse sochkar bharosa karna. Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony ko subscribe kijiye, har hafte naya episode aayega!

Adhyay:
0:00 Subah 7 baje, paani gayab!
1:03 Tanker aaya! Soap wala aaya!
1:57 Agla tanker teen din baad!
2:57 Ek balti mein nahana
4:01 Detective team ready hai
5:04 Science bolta hai... barish!
5:42 Aakhri tanker, bucket race
6:39 Class mein paani ka sabak
7:49 Das second ka countdown
8:52 Ek balti, ek kisaan, ek drama

Yeh ek kaalpanik comedy hai, parivaar ke hansi-mazaak aur scam se savdhaani ke liye; kisi asli vyakti ko nishana nahi banaya gaya.
